cause_quote: The diff added the `{ kind: "page", href: url.href }` fallback for ordinary external links and changed tooltip ownership to `Boolean(link && ownsHoverPreview(link))`, so the audit link's preview suppressed the nested icon's hint.
user_saw: With link previews enabled, hovering over the security audit info icon showed a preview of the audit page instead of the icon’s hint.
summary: The fix gives the info icon on plugin and Template pages its own explanatory tooltip button and moves the audit link to the verdict row.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent and confirmed that the plugin audit icon already had a title inside the audit link, and the tooltip code displayed it because ordinary ClawHub links were outside the existing preview matcher. PR #152758 made those links eligible for previews and suppressed their nested hints. The Template page later inherited the same behavior when it adopted the shared audit renderer.
